subject: pol-con
title: (R)POL.CON.------TR.
description: Diagram in MID-W-7, one page before Braxton describes the AACM as 'a non-profit collective organization, chartered by the State of Illinois, formed solely for the purpose of creating a more meaningful environment for both the creative musician and the community.' (R)POL-CON (the reality of political consciousness) is crossed with TR (transformation). The structural pairing is direct: real political consciousness is what crosses with transformation. DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) branches from the main line and opens into INFO-CON (information convergence) and C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). RT-OP (reality options) branches from the main line and opens into TH-AF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment) → INTR (interpretation).
